summary: A large-scale data center is a facility of more than 25,000 square feet of gross floor area or more than 20 MW on a contiguous site under common ownership. Permitted only through Planned Area Development or Planned Community Development rezoning or a major amendment; no by-right approval and no special exception.
notes: Adopted August 5 2026 on a 6-1 vote (Council Member Nikki Lee dissenting); effective September 4 2026.
